posts.title: Extracting Reddit Data with AI
posts.description: A few days ago, I stumbled upon a Reddit thread packed with API recommendations. The thread was long, detailed, and exactly what I needed—except I didn’t want to manually comb through dozens of comments. I figured this was the perfect job for AI. Spoiler alert: it wasn’t as straightforward as I expected.

posts.title: Installing Java in 2025, and Version Managers
posts.description: Remember when installing Java meant one download, one version, once choice?
